# Models and fields

Fexu models are Rust structs deriving `FexuModel`. The CLI creates and registers a model in the correct app automatically.

```sh
fexu new app catalog
fexu generate model Book --app catalog
```

**File: `apps/catalog/models/book.rs`** (generated by the fullstack template):

```rust
use fexu::prelude::*;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(FexuModel, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[fexu(
    table = "books",
    api = "/api/v1/books",
    admin = true,
    admin_label = "Book",
    permissions = "books"
)]
pub struct Book {
    #[field(primary_key, auto)]
    pub id: Uuid,

    #[field(required, min_length = 1)]
    pub name: String,
}
```

For an existing table, create a migration after changing the struct:

```sh
fexu migrate make add_stock --app catalog --backfill books.stock:i64=0
fexu migrate plan
fexu migrate up
```

Supported model field types include UUIDs, strings, integers, booleans, decimal values, date/time values and nullable forms of supported values. Field attributes provide validation and schema metadata.

```rust
#[field(min = 0)]
pub stock: i64,
```

Place the field **inside** the Book struct, then generate the migration. Fexu does not silently alter an existing database just because you changed a Rust struct. For authenticated models, permissions remain mandatory for protected operations.

See [database](database.md), [migrations](migrations.md), and the [complete tutorial](../tutorial/first-project.md).
